senses.gloss: तद् (I) pron. (nom. sing. सः m., सा f., and तत् n.) 1. He, she, it; 2. that, referring to something not present (तदिति परोक्षे विजानीयात्); 3. that (relating to something seen or experienced before), तन्मंजु मंदहसितं श्वसितानि तानि सा वै कलंकविधुरा मधुराननश्रीः Bh.V.ii.5; 4. that (meaning well-known or celebrated), सा रम्या नगरी महान्स नृपतिः सान्तचक्रं च तत् Bhartr.iii.37.With a following एव, तद् means ‘the same, identical, that very.’ It is sometimes used with the 1st and 2nd personal pronouns as well as with demonstratives and relatives for the sake of emphasis, सोऽहमिज्याविशुद्धात्मा R.i.68.When repeated, it has the sense of ‘various,’ ‘several’ Bg.vii.20.(The inst. sing. तेन is used as an indeclinable, in the sense of ‘therefore, for that reason, on that account.’)

तद् (II) ind. 1. Thither; 2. then, at that time, in that case; 3. therefore, consequently, Megh.i.7; 4. then (as a correlative of यदि), यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः । धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् Bg.i.45.
तद्-अनंतरम् ind. immediately after that, thereupon, then.
तद्-अनु ind. after that, तदनु ववृषुः पुष्पमाश्चर्यमेघाः R.xvi.87.
तद्-अंत a. perishing in that, ending thus.
तद्-अर्थ, -अर्थीय a. intended for that.
तद्-अर्थ, -अर्थीय a. intended for that.
तद्-अर्ह a. meriting that.
तद्-अवधि ind. 1. so far, up to that period, till then, तदवधि कुशली पुराणशास्त्रस्मृतिशतचारुविचारजो विवेकः Bh.V.ii.14; 2. from that time.
तद्-एकचित्त a. having the mind exclusively fixed on that.
तद्-गत a. directed to that, intent on that, belonging to that.
तद्-गुण m. a figure of speech thus defined- स्वमुत्सृज्य गुणैर्योगादत्युज्ज्वलगुणस्य यत् । वस्तु तद्गुणतामेति भण्यते स तु तद्गुणः K.Pr.x.
तद्-धन a. miserly.
तद्-बल m. a kind of arrow.
तद्-वत् (I) a. containing or possessed of that, e.g. तद्वानपोहो वा शब्दार्थः K.Pr.ii.
तद्-वत् (II) ind. 1. like that, in that manner, thus; 2. equally, likewise.
तद्-वाचक a. signifying that.
तद्-विद् a. 1. knowing that; 2. knowing the truth.
तद्-विध a. of that kind, of that nature, R.ii.22, K.S.v.73.
तदा ind. 1. At that time, then; 2. in that case, M.i.55.तदा प्रभृति ‘from that time forward,’ K.S.i.53.
तदा-त्व n. the present time, the time being.
तदा-मुख a. commenced, begun.
तदानीम् ind. At that time, then.
तदानीम्-तन a. belonging to that time, तदानींतनश्च संवृतः Ut.i.
तदीय a. (f. या) Belonging to him, her or that, R.i.81, ii.28.
तदीय a. (f. या) Belonging to him, her or that, R.i.81, ii.28.
तादात्म्य n. Sameness of nature, identity, unity, नयनयोस्तादात्म्यमंभोरुहाम् Bh.V.ii.81.
तादृक्ष a. (f. क्षी) Such-like, like him, her or it, Am.S.46.(तादृश when coupled with its relative यादृश means ‘common, ordinary, low,’ उपदेशो न दातव्यो यादृशे तादृशे जने Panch.i.)
